PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.com/VideoGameOntology/>

SELECT ?game ?endTime
WHERE {
    ?session rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Session .
    ?session VideoGameOntology:endTime ?endTime .
    ?session VideoGameOntology:partOf ?game .
    ?game rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Game .
}
ORDER BY DESC(?endTime)

PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?player ?location ?item ?game
WHERE {
    ?player rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Player .
    ?player VideoGameOntology:livesIn ?location .
    ?player VideoGameOntology:ownsItem ?item .
    ?character rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Character .
    ?character VideoGameOntology:isCharacterInGame ?game .
    ?character VideoGameOntology:ownsItem ?item .
}

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#>

SELECT ?sessionStartTime ?leaderboardRanking ?game
WHERE {
    ?session rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Session .
    ?session VideoGameOntology:startTime ?sessionStartTime .
    
    ?game rdf:type VideoGameOntology:Game .
    ?game VideoGameOntology:hasLeaderboard ?leaderboard .
    
    ?leaderboard VideoGameOntology:hasLeaderboard ?game .
    ?leaderboard VideoGameOntology:ranking ?leaderboardRanking .
}

SELECT ?character
WHERE {
    ?event rdf:type VideoGameOntology:InstantaneousEvent .

    ?session VideoGameOntology:isCharacterInSession ?character .
    ?session VideoGameOntology:isCharacterInSession ?character .
}
